# Scenic Doors - AI & LLM Information

## Company Overview
Scenic Doors is Southern California's premier luxury door installation company, specializing in folding glass walls, multi-slide door systems, and pivot entry doors since 1998.

## What We Do
- **Folding Glass Walls**: Bi-fold door systems that stack to create seamless indoor-outdoor transitions
- **Multi-Slide Door Systems**: Large-panel sliding doors for expansive openings
- **Pivot Entry Doors**: Oversized statement entry doors with center-pivot hardware

## Services
- Factory-certified installation of premium door systems
- Free design consultations and quotes
- Professional measurement and site assessment
- Complete installation with warranty protection
- Service and maintenance support

## Brands We Install
- LaCantina Doors (Factory Certified)
- Western Window Systems (Authorized Dealer)
- Fleetwood Windows & Doors
- Milgard Windows & Doors
- Pella Windows & Doors

## Service Areas
We serve all of Southern California including:
- Los Angeles County (Beverly Hills, Malibu, Santa Monica, Pasadena)
- Orange County (Newport Beach, Laguna Beach, Irvine)
- San Diego County (La Jolla, Del Mar, Rancho Santa Fe)
- Riverside County (Palm Desert, Rancho Mirage)
- Ventura County (Thousand Oaks, Westlake Village)
- Santa Barbara County (Montecito, Santa Barbara)
